conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The association of owls with wisdom dates back to ancient Greece, where the owl was the sacred animal of Athena, the goddess of wisdom. Its nocturnal nature and large, watchful eyes likely contributed to this symbolic connection.
